sales_dip_recovery_promo.template: Hi {customer_name}! 👋 {merchant_name} misses you. Enjoy {discount_pct}% off on {item_name} this week only. Visit us or reply to this message to reserve yours. Valid till {expiry_date}.
guardrails: discount_pct must not exceed merchant's configured max_discount_pct (default 15%)
max 1 promo per customer per 14 days

restock_reminder_to_merchant.template: {item_name} is running low ({stock_qty} left, sells ~{avg_daily_units}/day). Reorder now to avoid a stockout in ~{days_to_stockout} days.

loan_eligibility_nudge.channel: Paytm Merchant App + AI Soundbox voice prompt
loan_eligibility_nudge.template: Based on your last {lookback_months} months of settlements, you're pre-approved for a working capital loan of up to ₹{max_loan_inr} at {interest_rate}% for {tenure_months} months. Tap to apply — no paperwork needed.
guardrails: Never shown more than once per 30 days to the same merchant
Requires explicit one-tap consent before any application is submitted

templates.return_policy: {merchant_name}'s return window is {return_days} days with original receipt.
